instruction: Use the right arm to set the red can in the basket with rounded edges; another arm lifts the basket with rounded edges.

source.instruction: Use the right arm to set the red can in the basket with rounded edges; another arm lifts the basket with rounded edges.

arm_note: ARM CHOICE in this demonstration: the RIGHT arm grasped the can, which was at x = +21 (right half of the table); the LEFT arm grasped the basket, which was at x = -2 (left half of the table). The arm was chosen by the object's x position (x < 0 -> LEFT arm, x > 0 -> RIGHT arm; each arm reaches only ~15 cm past the centre line). In YOUR scene the objects may be on the other side: choose the arm from your own object positions, not from the demonstration.

frames.label: turn 1
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.93; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.93; table z = 74
frames.plan: Move right gripper above red can around (21, 3, 94) pointing down.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (-9, +22, +0) cm, now 1 cm (horizontal) / +20 cm (vertical) from the can

frames.label: turn 2
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (21, 3, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Rotate yaw by 45 degrees and lower gripper to z = 86.5 cm.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (+0, +0, -8) cm, now 1 cm (horizontal) / +12 cm (vertical) from the can

frames.label: turn 3
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (21, 3, 86) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Fine-adjust xy and descend to z = 81.5 cm to align with the can body.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (-0, +1, -5) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +8 cm (vertical) from the can

frames.label: turn 4
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (21, 3, 82) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Adjust yaw slightly and close right gripper to grasp the can.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips stayed in place, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +8 cm (vertical) from the can; closed the gripper (opening 0.48: holding the can)

frames.label: turn 5
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (21, 3, 82) opening 0.48; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lift can up to z = 95 cm, point forward, orient yaw, and translate left towards basket.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (-21, +4, +14) cm, now 8 cm (horizontal) / +0 cm (vertical) from the can

frames.label: turn 6
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (-0, 7, 95) opening 0.50; table z = 74
frames.plan: Shift right gripper closer to basket center in y and lift slightly to z = 100 cm.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (+0, -7, +5) cm, now 7 cm (horizontal) / +26 cm (vertical) from the basket

frames.label: turn 7
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (0, 0, 100) opening 0.50; table z = 74
frames.plan: Fine tune x position slightly by +1 cm.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (+1, -0, -0) cm, now 8 cm (horizontal) / +26 cm (vertical) from the basket

frames.label: turn 8
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (1, 0, 100) opening 0.49; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lower right arm down to z = 90 cm into the basket opening.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (+0, -0, -10) cm, now 8 cm (horizontal) / +0 cm (vertical) from the can

frames.label: turn 9
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (1, 0, 90) opening 0.49; table z = 74
frames.plan: Open right gripper to release red can into the basket.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips stayed in place, now 7 cm (horizontal) / +5 cm (vertical) from the can; opened the gripper

frames.label: turn 10
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (1, 0, 90) opening 0.90; table z = 74
frames.plan: Point left gripper down, rotate yaw to +75 deg, and move right towards basket.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+28, +0, +0) cm, now 12 cm (horizontal) / +20 cm (vertical) from the basket

frames.label: turn 11
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-2, -19, 94) opening 0.95; RIGHT fingertips (1, 0, 90) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Move left arm forward towards basket handle and send right arm home.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+0, +12, -0) cm, now 1 cm (horizontal) / +20 cm (vertical) from the basket; RIGHT fingertips moved by (+29, -20, +4) cm, now 35 cm (horizontal) / +20 cm (vertical) from the basket

frames.label: turn 12
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-2, -8, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Fine tune xy and lower left gripper to z = 91.5 cm around the handle.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+0, +0, -2) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +17 cm (vertical) from the basket

frames.label: turn 13
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-2, -7, 92) opening 0.95; RIGHT fingertips (30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Rotate yaw to align with handle and close left gripper.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips stayed in place, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +17 cm (vertical) from the basket; closed the gripper (opening 0.15: holding the basket)

frames.label: turn 14
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-2, -7, 91) opening 0.15; RIGHT fingertips (30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Close left gripper completely to secure grip.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips stayed in place, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +17 cm (vertical) from the basket

frames.label: turn 15
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-2, -7, 91) opening 0.15; RIGHT fingertips (30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lift left arm by +2 cm to lift basket off the table.
